title: Producing his first concert, Brass Bands to Bebop at Jordan Hall
summary: The first George Wein Presents concert with Hall, Wild Bill Davison, Newton and Higginbotham sold out Jordan Hall.

blocks.x: Your entrepreneurial spirit kicked in yet again.
Well, one week we did not have a gig, so I said to Edmund Hall, "Why don't we do our own concert?" That was how I happened to produce my first concert: George Wein Presents.
Was that the Brass Bands to BeBop?

Brass Bands to BeBop. Nat Hentoff wrote the album notes and MC'd the program. I brought up Wild Bill Davison and Frankie Newton and J.C. [Higginbotham] from New York, and we sold out Jordan Hall in Boston. Beautiful hall … at the New England Conservatory of Music. I guess that was the first bite of the insect that infected me the rest of my life.
I guess that was the date. I guess that was the date, you know.
